articles.title: Peel Region's new council chair on the 'tumultuous new world' of strong regional chairs
articles.summary: Peel Region's new provincially appointed council chair said he recognizes the "tumultuous" circumstances that led to his appointment, during his first message to council on inauguration day.

articles.title: Man dead after being struck by vehicle in Mississauga, police say
articles.summary: A man is dead after being struck by a vehicle in Mississauga on Thursday evening, police say.

articles.title: Man struck and killed in Mississauga
articles.summary: A pedestrian has been struck and killed in Mississauga.

articles.title: Vehicle ticketed in Toronto minutes after rush hour sign change — and driver is not happy
articles.summary: A Toronto resident is speaking out after he received a $120 parking ticket in Parkdale minutes after crews took down old traffic signs and put up new ones that changed the no-stopping times on a stretch of Queen Street W. Police say they will request tickets issued during the sign change be cancelled.

articles.title: Mayor Chow turns down police board seat, names new TTC chair while shuffling leadership roles at City Hall
articles.summary: City Council resumed Thursday after Mayor Olivia Chow and city councillors were sworn in on Wednesday and at the top of the agenda was naming members to various boards, committees, agencies and corporations. articles.title: College of physicians not investigating MP over MAID comments
articles.summary: OTTAWA — The College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario says it's not investigating a member of Parliament who received a complaint over comments he made about medical assistance in dying.

articles.title: Mayor Chow turns down police board seat, shakes up city hall leadership with new councillors for committees
articles.summary: Mayor Olivia Chow shuffled her leadership team at city hall on Thursday, tapping a former Liberal MP to head up the housing committee and her Scarborough deputy as transit chair.

articles.title: Police release images of SUV involved in hit-and-run near Mt. Pleasant and Jarvis
articles.summary: Toronto Police have released images of an SUV that allegedly ran over a pedestrian and fled the scene on Nov. 3 in the area of Mt. Pleasant Road and Jarvis Street. articles.title: NSL champions AFC Toronto celebrated at city hall
articles.summary: Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow proclaimed November 19 as 'AFC Toronto Day' in celebration of the club's Northern Super League championship title. CBC News' Dana Roberts was there and spoke with players and fans.

articles.title: SIU charges Halton police officer after shooting of Burlington, Ont., man in motel parking lot
articles.summary: A Halton police officer has been charged, according to the Ontario police watchdog, after shooting a 23-year-old man multiple times.

articles.title: This Etobicoke mall was transformed into the set of Netflix's latest game show
articles.summary: When Charles Wachter was tasked with finding a “fantasy mall” for Netflix’s new reality competition show, Win the Mall, he turned to his hometown shopping centre: Sherway Gardens in Etobicoke. But the showrunner says transforming the retail mecca into a game show set was a logistical challenge.

articles.title: Chow turns down police board seat, selects new committee heads at city hall
articles.summary: Mayor Olivia Chow again turned down a post on the Toronto police board Thursday. She also opted to shake up high-profile committee roles, charging newly elected and veteran allies with key positions.

articles.title: Peel police charge off-duty Sudbury police sergeant and 1 other following altercation in Mississauga
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police say they charged two Sudbury men after an altercation at a hotel in Mississauga on November 7. A spokesperson with Sudbury police confirms one of them is a sergeant with Greater Sudbury Police Service.
